name: parenthesized precedence
test: print(calculate_iii('2*(3+4)'))

name: negative numerator truncation
test: print(calculate_iii('(0-7)/2'))

name: negative denominator truncation
test: print(calculate_iii('7/(0-2)'))

name: left-associative integer division
test: print(calculate_iii('18/3/2'))

name: spaces and nesting
test: print(calculate_iii(' 12 + ( 3 * (4 - 2) ) '))

test: print(calculate_iii('-(2+3)*4'))

test: print(calculate_iii('7/2'))

name: decimal precedence
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('1.5*(2+3)/2')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, 3.75, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: real division
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('7/2')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, 3.5, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: negative real division
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('(0-7)/2')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, -3.5, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: decimal leading zero and rounding
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('0.1+0.2')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, 0.3, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: spaces and unary signs
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal(' - ( 1.25 + +2.75 ) / 2 ')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, -2.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: left-associative real division
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('9/2/3')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, 1.5, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)

name: unary after binary operator
test:
import math
value = calculate_decimal('1+-2.5')
assert isinstance(value, float)
assert math.isclose(value, -1.5, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)
